aj7570.bio: Named in the dataset's chains and matched to entries in the scholars' biographical books. No Taqrīb profile has been matched yet; the verdicts below are quoted from the books cited.
s: Name as indexed in a chain
as: الخليفة صحابي أسلم قبل الفتح وكتب الوحي
A caliph and Companion who embraced Islam before the conquest and wrote down revelation.
Abū Nuʿaym, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
كان من الكتبة الحسبة الفصحاء، حليما وقورا
He was among the scribes skilled in calculation and eloquent, forbearing and dignified.
Ibn ʿAbbās, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
Ibn ʿAbbās, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
ما رأيت أحدا أحلى للملك من معاوية
I have seen no one more suited to kingship than Muʿāwiyah.
عمر, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
This is the Kisrā of the Arabs.
ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
ما رأيت إلا خيرا، وما بلغني إلا خير
I have seen only good and only good has reached me concerning him.
سعد بن أبو وقاص, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
We performed ʿumrah in the pilgrimage months while this man was still a disbeliever.
ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
ما بك إلطافك نفسك بأطيب الطعام وتصبحك حتى تضرب الشمس متنيك، وذوو الحاجات وراء الباب
Your condition comes from pampering yourself with the finest food and sleeping late while supplicants wait outside.
Ibn ʿAbbās, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
إنه صحب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
He had the companionship of the Messenger of God.
أبو سفيان, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
إن ابني هذا لعظيم الرأس، وإنه لخليق أنه يسود قومه
My son has a large head and is likely to lead his people.
عمر, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
This is the Kisrā of the Arabs.
عمر, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
إن كان ما قلت حقا إنه لرأي أريب، وإن كان باطلا إنه لخدعة أديب
If what you said is true, it is a clever judgment. If false, it is a skilled deception.
عمرو, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
ما أحسن ما صدر الفتى عما أوردته فيه
How well the young man extricated himself from what you put to him.
عمر, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
دعونا من ذم فتى قريش من يضحك في الغضب، ولا ينال ما عنده إلا على الرضا، ولا يؤخذ ما فوق رأسه إلا من تحت قدميه
Leave off censuring the young man of Quraysh, who laughs when angry. What he has can be obtained only with his goodwill, and what is above his head can be taken only from under his feet.
Ibn ʿUmar, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
كانوا والله خيرا من معاوية، وكان معاوية أسود منهم
By God, Abū Bakr, ʿUmar, ʿUthmān and ʿAlī were better than Muʿāwiyah, while he showed more of the bearing of a chief.
The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
اللهم علم معاوية الكتاب والحساب وقه العذاب
O God, teach Muʿāwiyah writing and reckoning and protect him from punishment.
The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
May God not fill his belly.
المسور بن مخرمة, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
فلم أدع شيئا أعيبه عليه إلا بينته له
I held back none of the faults I had to reproach him with, but laid them out to him.
عبد الرحمن ابن حسان, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
فإنا صابرون ومنظروكم ... إلى يوم التغابن والخصام
We are patient and await you until the day of mutual loss and disputation.
Ibn ʿUmar, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
ما رأيت أحدا بعد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أسود من معاوية
After the Messenger, I saw no one more commanding than Muʿāwiyah.
المسور بن مخرمة, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
ففكرت حين قال ما قال، فعرفت أنه خصمني
I thought over his words and realized that he had prevailed over me in argument.
The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by Ibn al-Athīr
اللهم، اجعله هاديا مهديا، واهد به
O God, make him a guide who is himself guided, and guide others through him.
Ibn ʿAbbās, quoted by Ibn al-Athīr
Ibn ʿUmar, quoted by Ibn al-Athīr
كانوا- والله- خيرا من معاوية وأفضل، ومعاوية أسود
By God, Abū Bakr, ʿUmar, ʿUthmān and ʿAlī were better and more virtuous than Muʿāwiyah, while Muʿāwiyah showed more of the bearing of a chief.
ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, quoted by Ibn al-Athīr
This is the Kisrā of the Arabs.
The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by Ibn al-Athīr
May God not fill his belly.
الضحاك بن قيس, quoted by Ibn al-Athīr
إن أمير المؤمنين معاوية كان حد العرب، وعود العرب، قطع الله به الفتنة، وملكه على العباد، وسير جنوده في البر والبحر
Muʿāwiyah was a bulwark and mainstay of the Arabs. God ended the discord through him, made him ruler over his servants, and he sent armies out by land and sea.
وكان هو وأبوه من المؤلفة قلوبهم، وحسن إسلامهما
He and his father were among those whose hearts were to be reconciled, and they practised Islam well.
Ibn ʿUmar, quoted by Ibn al-Athīr
ما رأيت أحدا بعد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أسود من معاوية
After the Messenger, I saw no one more commanding than Muʿāwiyah.

t259.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Ibrāhīm ibn Mūsā ibn Yazīd al-Tamīmī, Abū Isḥāq al-Farrāʾ al-Rāzī, called al-Ṣaghīr, trustworthy and a memorizer, of the tenth generation, who died after 220.
as: Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
وكان أحمد بن حنبل ينكر على من يقول له الصغير، ويقول: هو كبير في العلم والجلالة
Aḥmad objected to calling him ‘the Younger,’ saying he was great in learning and standing.
Abū Zurʿah al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
هو أتقن من أبي بكر بن أبي شيبة، وأصح حديثا منه، لا يحدث إلا من كتابه، لا أعلم أني كتبت خمسين حديثا من حفظه، وهو أتقن وأحفظ من صفوان بن صالح

He was more precise than Abū Bakr ibn Abī Shaybah and his reports were sounder. He transmitted from his book. I do not think I wrote even fifty hadiths he gave from memory. He was more precise and had a better memory than Ṣafwān ibn Ṣāliḥ.
Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
من الثقات وهو أتقن من أبي جعفر الجمال
One of the reliable transmitters and more precise than Abū Jaʿfar al-Jammāl.

t5247.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records al-ʿAlāʾ ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Yaʿqūb al-Ḥuraqī, Abū Shibl al-Madanī, as truthful but sometimes having illusions, of the fifth generation, who died in the thirties.
as: Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
ثقة لم أسمع أحدا ذكره بسوء.
Trustworthy. I heard no one speak badly of him.
Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
العلاء بن عبد الرحمن عندي فوق سهيل، وفوق محمد بن عمرو.
I rank al-ʿAlāʾ above Suhayl and Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
ليس بذا، لم يزل الناس يتوقون حديثه.
He was of limited standing, and people had long been wary of his reports.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
ليس حديثه بحجة، وهو وسهيل قريب من السواء
His hadith is not proof. He and Suhayl are close to equal.
Abū Zurʿah al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
He was less than very strong.
Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
صالح، روى عنه الثقات، ولكنه أنكر من حديثه أشياء، وهو عندي أشبه من العلاء بن المسيب.
He was acceptable and trustworthy people narrated from him, though some of his reports were rejected. Abū Ḥātim found him more suitable than al-ʿAlāʾ ibn al-Musayyab.
وللعلاء نسخ عن أبيه عن أبي هريرة يرويها عنه الثقات، وما أرى به بأسا.
Trustworthy people transmitted his collections from his father on Abū Hurayrah's authority. Ibn ʿAdī saw no objection to him.
Ibn Ḥibbān listed him among trustworthy transmitters.

t6026.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAbbās al-Hāshimī as acceptable (maqbūl) of the fourth generation; he was the brother of ʿAlī and paternal uncle of Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, and whoever conflated the two erred.

t6053.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Numayr al-Hamadānī al-Kūfī, Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, as trustworthy, a memorizer and virtuous, of the tenth generation, who died in the year 34.
as: Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
Trustworthy, and his hadith can be used as evidence.
Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
What a fine young man he is.
Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير درة العراق.
Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Numayr is the pearl of Iraq.
ما رأيت بالكوفة مثل محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير، وكان رجلا قد جمع العلم والفهم والسنة والزهد
I saw no one like Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Numayr in Kufa. He combined learning, understanding, adherence to the Sunnah and asceticism.
أحمد بن سنان القطان, quoted by al-Mizzī
ما رأيت من الكوفيين من أحداثهم رجلا أفضل عندي من محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير
I saw no young Kufan whom I held in higher esteem than Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Numayr.
كوفي ثقة، ويعد من أصحاب الحديث.
A trustworthy Kufan counted among the hadith specialists.
محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير أثبت من أبيه.
Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Numayr was more dependable than his father.
وكان من الحفاظ المتقنين وأهل الورع في الدين.
He was among the precise masters of hadith and the religiously scrupulous.

t8550.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Jadāma bint Wahb al-Asadiyya, maternal sister of ʿUkāsha ibn Miḥṣan, as a Companion with precedence and emigration; al-Dāraquṭnī said those who write it with dotted dhāl have erred.
as: Whoever says it with the dotted dhāl has made a scribal error.

t8785.bio: Ibn Ḥajar states that the daughter of Zayd ibn Thābit al-Anṣāriyya was a Medinan jurist mentioned in the beginning of al-Bukhārī.
